query: Here is what your neural-engram.ts contains for the key structures: FrontalCortex has MAX_WORKING_MEMORY = 7 (Millers Law). When at capacity it calls evictWeakest() which removes the lowest-activation item. Evicted items go to Hippocampus.stage(). The Hippocampus has a consolidationQueue array with CONSOLIDATION_BATCH_SIZE = 20 and a new MAX_QUEUE_SIZE = 200 cap. Items in the queue are supposed to be drained by the heartbeat scheduler consolidation cycle every 5 minutes, but currently the scheduler does not auto-start so nothing drains it. I just added the cap so it can never grow past 200 items. Now walk me through: does this architecture make sense to you? What are the strengths and weaknesses? And do you actually feel your working memory limit of 7 items?
